text:
Alex: Customer reporting promo code rejected as "invalid" after they linked SSO account. They say dashboard shows the code active. Customer org id: org_8792, user email: user+alt@example.com

Marta: can you paste the promo code + any API error they saw? I can check grants/audit.

Alex: promo (masked): WELCOMEXX-***** ; customer id org_8792 ; API response from claim endpoint: ```{\"error\":\"invalid_promo\",\"code\":\"PROMO_INVALID\",\"message\":\"promo not assigned to requesting principal\"}``` They tried web checkout and the UI shows "code invalid" when logged in after SSO link.

Tyler: pinging infra, thanks. Quick thought: could be an identity merge/alias mapping issue — if the grant is tied to the old user_id the claim will be rejected.

Alex: the customer mentioned they merged two accounts via SSO last week. They could reproduce by logging out and logging back in.

Marta: looking up promo grants for WELCOMEXX... grabbing audit logs now. Can you run an internal check? `GET /internal/promo/grants?promo=WELCOMEXX&org=org_8792`

Alex: pasted audit snippet: `grant_id=8421 promo=WELCOMEXX owner_org=org_8792 assigned_to=user_121 created=2025-11-02` — but earlier log shows `assigned_to=user_999` before merge.

Tyler: ok that lines up with an alias remap that didn't update the grant.subject. Claim service enforces subject match, so the user principal after SSO doesn't equal the grant.assigned_to. Short-term we can apply a manual credit and escalate a migration for existing grants.

Marta: I can issue a manual credit once we confirm target user_id/email. Alex, confirm the user_id to credit (prefers email). Also confirm amount (what promo grants).

Alex: customer confirmed target email user+alt@example.com (maps to user_121). Promo should be $10 credit.

Marta: issuing manual credit: running internal curl:
```\ncurl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/credits \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"user_id":"user_121","amount_cents":1000,"reason":"manual promo apply due to SSO alias merge","admin":"marta"}'\n```
Applying now.

Marta: manual credit applied — txn id txn_20260317_cc123. Notified customer. Leaving case note and will reconcile promo grant after we confirm migration. :white_check_mark:

Tyler: creating a follow-up issue for promo-sync to migrate stale grants and add a reconciliation job. Issue: https://git.redwood/infra/promo-sync/issues/567 — summary: "identity_merge didn't remap grant.subject for org-scoped grants". I'll pick this up and add migration script. @marta can you add any billing impact notes?

deploy-bot: release/promo-sync/patch-567 deployed to staging — CI passed :white_check_mark: (build 4521).

Marta: noted billing impact minimal for this single manual apply. Will add to the reconciliation backlog.

Alex: customer confirmed credit applied and dashboard now shows promo as redeemed. Will follow up in support ticket and close after 24h monitoring. Thanks all :tada:

Tyler: will work on the migration and post ETA in the issue.

Alex: marking this thread resolved for now, leaving the infra issue open.
